summary: Magma Partners backs entrepreneurs in Latin America from pre-seed to Series A and says it would love to be a company's first investor. Its homepage reports more than 125 startups backed with more than $80,000,000 invested, describes the firm as a generalist best known for fintech, insurtech and marketplaces, and asks founders to create a Magma Memo rather than use the general contact form. Check size and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage states more than 125 startups backed with more than $80M over eight years; the companies page lists them without dates on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: Latin America focus, stages, generalist view with fintech and marketplaces, Magma Memo route
Contact page: founders directed to the Magma Memo instead of the form
